ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white/light-gray pixels occupy approximately 85% of the visible surface, contrasted by a low-intensity black perimeter along the trailing edge and tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile. Continuous jagged peaks and valleys (amplitude 3-10 pixels) observed across the entire trailing edge from the left tip to the right tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, vertical low-intensity linear streaks are detectable on the lower central and right-central fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged erosion and minor tissue loss visible on the distal point of the right lobe; dark scarring present at the base of the notch.
